title: Bot tactical power-up + dash usage — Kick/Remote/Throw/Pierce/Shield/Bomb Pass + Dash strategic decisions per personality
intent: Bots currently COLLECT all 9 power-ups + dash but USE them only passively. Multiple GDPs (Kick S100, Remote S104, Pierce S142, Throw Glove S144, Bomb Pass S152, Shield S109, Dash S159) explicitly deferred 'bot doesn't strategise around it' for follow-up. This story implements those deferred bot smarts in ONE consolidated batch: each personality (Hunter/Coward/Miner) gets per-power-up strategic weights driving when to USE each verb. Bots become readable opponents — Hunter kicks bombs at players, Coward dashes to escape blasts + uses shield to take risks, Miner uses pierce on long soft-block rows. Bots feel intentional, not just-walking-and-bombing.
rationale: Source: deferred acceptance hints across GDP-026-002/003/004/006/007 + GDP-006 (Shield) + S159 (Dash). All said 'bot uses passively, strategic AI is follow-up'. After 30+ sprints since these shipped, the gap is visible — bots have 9 power-up arsenal but feel mechanical. Marked `should` because bots WORK without this (Hunter S125 chase is decent), but tactical use multiplies the perceived intelligence × 5.
acceptanceHints: TARGET FILE: examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/bot-ai-system.ts — main decision loop extension. Tactical-use submodules under examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/bot/ for organisation.
PER-POWER-UP TACTICAL RULES:
KICK (S100) — bot has BomberStats.canKick:
Hunter: when player is in line-of-sight on the cell ADJACENT to bot's bomb → walk INTO own bomb (kick it toward player). Aggressive kick attack.
Coward: when own bomb is adjacent + danger map score on bomb cell > 0.5 → walk INTO bomb (kick it AWAY from self + toward open cell). Defensive kick.
Miner: ignores kick — just collects.
REMOTE (S104) — bot has BomberStats.canRemote:
Hunter: place bomb on cell where player path-prediction crosses; remote-detonate the moment player enters bomb's cell. 'Trap with manual trigger'.
Coward: place bomb behind self when fleeing; remote-detonate when chaser enters blast range. Defensive trap.
Miner: place bomb near soft block row; remote-detonate when nobody's around (no chain risk). Patient miner.
All personalities: remote bomb fuse PAUSES (per S104 rule) — bot keeps moving normally with bomb sitting indefinitely. Track 'have armed remote bomb' state per bot.
THROW GLOVE (S144) — bot has BomberStats.canThrow:
Hunter: pick up own bomb, throw 3 cells toward player's predicted position. Lobs over walls.
Coward: pick up own bomb, throw AWAY from self toward an empty corner. Escape verb (gets bomb off own danger map).
Miner: pick up bomb, throw at a 3+ row of soft blocks. Efficient mining.
Trigger: 30% probability per fixedUpdate when bomber stands on own bomb + has canThrow. Avoid every-frame thrashing.
PIERCE (S142) — bot has BomberStats.canPierce:

Hunter + Miner: prefer placing bombs in cells where a pierce blast would clear MULTIPLE soft blocks in one direction (use existing soft-block-counting from danger-map computations). Bias bomb-placement toward high-pierce-value cells.
Coward: ignore pierce — places bombs same as without (pierce is offensive, not defensive).
SHIELD (S109) — bot has BomberStats.canShield:
ALL personalities: when canShield is true, danger-map scores are REDUCED by 50% (bot is willing to enter cells that would otherwise be too dangerous, knowing the shield absorbs one hit).
Hunter: takes especially aggressive bomb-place risks when shielded — places bombs in adjacent-to-player cells without escape route.
Coward: maintains a smaller safe-flee distance when shielded.
Miner: ventures into newly-blasted areas earlier (collects pickups in still-warm zones).
BOMB PASS (S152) — bot has BomberStats.canBombPass:
ALL personalities: pathfinding edge cost for own-bomb cells drops to 0 (per S152 acceptance — already implemented passively).
Hunter: places bomb behind itself while chasing player + passes through it (was previously blocked). Chase-without-self-block.
Coward: places bombs to wall off pursuer (knowing self can pass back through them).
DASH (S159) — universal cooldown 3s:
Coward: dash AWAY from imminent danger when danger-map score on current cell > 0.7. Highest dash use frequency (~every 4s when needed).
Hunter: dash TOWARD player when in line-of-sight + within 4 cells. Closes distance for kick-attack range. Every ~6s.
Miner: dash THROUGH soft block obstacles to reach unmined cells. Every ~8s — exploration focus.
Decision throttle per personality (don't spam dash even when criteria met more often).
PER-POWER-UP STATE TRACKING:
Bot AI gains per-bomber state: { remoteArmedAt?: number, lastDashAt: number, lastThrowAt: number, lastKickAt: number, lastPickupTarget?: cell }.
Cooldowns per action class prevent spamming.
DECISION COMPOSITION (per bot fixedUpdate):
1. Compute danger map (existing).
2. Compute opportunity map per power-up (NEW — what's the score for kick/remote/throw/pierce/dash/etc).
3. Pick the HIGHEST-SCORING action across all available verbs, weighted by personality.
4. If 'place bomb' wins: existing path. If 'kick own bomb' wins: walk into own bomb cell. If 'dash' wins: enqueue dash request. Etc.

DETERMINISM: bot RNG is seeded per fixedUpdate tick — same world seed + same observed state → same action. Bot-vs-bot regression continues to resolve in budget (likely shorter rounds — bots use more aggressive verbs).
PERFORMANCE: opportunity map computation ~O(N) per power-up checked × ~5 power-ups × 4 bombers = 20 evaluations per bot tick. Each evaluation simple grid math. Negligible per-frame cost.
TESTS:
Hunter bot with canKick + player in line-of-sight → walks into own bomb (kick toward player).
Coward bot with canDash + danger score > 0.7 on current cell → dashes away from danger.
Hunter bot with canRemote + bomb placed in player path → detonates remote bomb when player enters bomb cell.
Miner bot with canPierce → bomb placements bias toward high-soft-block-count rows.
Coward bot with canShield → danger-map scores reduced by 50%, takes more aggressive positioning.
All bots with canBombPass → pathfinding ignores own-bomb cells.
Bot vs bot integration test passes within budget.
VISUAL QA:
Watch a Hunter bot during a round → visibly kicks bombs at player, dashes for chase, places bombs aggressively when shielded.
Watch a Coward bot → uses dash to escape, places bombs to wall off pursuer, takes shield-protected risky cells.
Watch a Miner bot → focused on soft block rows, uses pierce when applicable, ignores combat verbs unless cornered.
All three feel DISTINCT, not just 'same bot with different bomb-place rate'.
OUT OF SCOPE:
Bot vs bot coordination (S141 multi-bot solo) — bots don't share info / coordinate attacks. Separate story.
Bot anticipation of human player patterns (e.g. 'player always corners-up' → bot pre-corner). Static danger map only.
Bot personality SHIFTS (Coward becomes Hunter when winning) — separate story GDP-2026-05-29-010.
New power-ups for bots to use (none — same 9 as players).
Bot ramp/step-jump awareness (post GDP-011/015) — separate story when terrain features land.
Server-side AI implementations need parity (server-authoritative gameplay from S125) — extends server's bot-ai with same rules.
